## Verified maintained native portal chain — related batch, 2026-10-29

The three original BUILD-012 criteria are reviewed and fulfilled for the declared/pinned build and tested Linux/X11 GTK portal contract:

1. The maintained pinned `rfd0.17.2` removes the old standalone unmaintained ashpd/zbus/zvariant chain without incompatible transitive overrides. Accepted unchanged complete lock unions (93picker/48share) have92exact OSV crate queries and two direct `cargo-audit0.22.2` scans against the Git-bound1381-advisory database: zero matches, vulnerabilities or warnings, including informational warnings and no ignore/target/severity/stale filters. Those scans are reused, not rerun.
2. Real production owning JNI operations exercise single/multiple open, folder, exact empty/binary save, open/folder/save cancellation, untouched source/no destination and fresh reopen. [Save-only recovery40872975000](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40872975000) at `ba59440f5caa1594e3ec6d3dd102c886f089b7bd` is **SUCCESS1/1**, one fresh XML, Gradleexit0/267.08s, all868before/after inputs match exact historical Git. Exact paths, empty/binary bytes and owned file/dialog cleanup pass. Completed unchanged open/multiple at8f52a473 and cancellation at8c5c4be4 are explicitly method/helper/native-source bound and **reused, not fresh executions**. Their whole runs remain FAILED1pass/2fail and1pass/1fail/Gradle143 disk-reserve stop; the latter is not a whole-worker/pass certificate. The save driver clears the complete GTK entry with Ctrl+A; production-selected paths and original filename/byte assertions were not rewritten or weakened.
3. Actual Linuxx64/X11 GTK FileChooser-v3 session buses use EXTERNAL authentication, no mock/foreign user bus/automatic activation directories, and three clean owned service shutdowns on local and hosted executions. Pinned Rust/Cargo1.98 is verified by the accepted five-host/twenty empty-cache locked builds, reused with unchanged native inputs. This does not invent an older MSRV or certify a full KDE/GNOME/Wayland shell/native-parent integration.

Dependency BUILD-005/#39 is already verified/closed. JNI/framework/public package names and attribution are retained. Baseline advisories were informational maintenance warnings, not established exploits; their original records remain immutable.

Full native payload provenance (the hosted save report does not upload a binary/manifest), minimum-platform, ABI, full packaged consumers, ordinary dependency trust, legal/security and release gates remain independent and open. No packages, releases, deployments or Pages. Closing directly after important actual-result/original-criteria review, without waiting for the separate unresolved slider tests or replaying accepted checks. Additive receipts follow in `docs/development/evidence/linux-portal-functionality-batch-important-20261029/save-recovery003/github-ci001/`; original issue body/title/labels/history are preserved.
